extracted.intended_audience: Principal Investigators, senior/key personnel, and research administrators preparing NIH (PHS 398 / Research & Related) grant applications and budgets
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling an NIH PHS 398-style grant application, including biosketches, Research Plan (Specific Aims, Research Strategy), Research & Related budgets (Sections A–K) and required cover-page supplements; aimed at PIs and institutional grants administrators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — required information and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include NAME, eRA Commons user name, POSITION TITLE, and EDUCATION/TRAINING. Use the prescribed five-page maximum and the specified format for each person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table fields
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each entry provide INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE (if applicable), Completion Date MM/YYYY, and FIELD OF STUDY. Begin with earliest degree and include postdoctoral/residency when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement (Biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize relevant qualifications, training, positions, and specific experience that make the person well suited to the project; explain how the individual's background will contribute to the achievement of the project's aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Employment / Other experience and memberships
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Employment; Other experience and professional memberships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions with dates and institutions, and professional memberships or roles (e.g., reviewer roles, board memberships). Include relevant administrative roles, fellowships, and dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science (Biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Contributions to Science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the applicant's substantive scientific contributions and their impact — include specific projects, systems developed, or discoveries and explain relevance to the proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Additional Information: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance — Ongoing Research Support; Completed Research Support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List ongoing and completed research support with roles and dates; identify roles on major awards (e.g., Grants Manager, Authorized Representative).

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Research Plan required sections
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Research Plan — Introduction (for resubmission), Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Progress Report Publication List, plus other required sections (Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research, Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Letters of Support, Resource Sharing Plan(s), Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources, Appendix).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include each listed section in the Research Plan as applicable to the application type. Provide indicated attachments (e.g., Specific_Aims.pdf, Research_Strategy.pdf) and ensure required supplemental components are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims section
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims (section required in Research Plan).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the project's aims clearly and concisely; align aims to the significance and planned activities of the proposal (the example shows three concrete aims for training, staff development, and systems strengthening).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy — Significance
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Strategy — Significance (describe institutional context, need, and how proposed work addresses gaps).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain institutional background, current capacity gaps, and why the proposed project is important; tie significance to measurable institutional outcomes (e.g., improved NIH grants management capacity).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Sections A–K
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - SECTION A & B, C, D, E, F-K (Budget Periods) including Senior/Key Person (A), Other Personnel (B), Equipment (C), Travel (D), Participant/Trainee Support Costs (E), Other Direct Costs (F), Direct Costs (G), Indirect Costs (H), Total Direct and Indirect Costs (I), Fee (J), Total Costs and Fee (K), Budget Justification (L).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete each budget section for the appropriate budget period(s). Provide required fields (organization DUNS, budget type, start/end dates). Attach a single Budget Justification file (Budget_Justification.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person budget fields
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Senior/Key Person — For each senior/key person provide Prefix, First Name, Middle, Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary, Calendar/Academic/Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Benefits ($), and Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report effort in months and percent effort as applicable; include salary and fringe/detail for each listed senior/key person, and list any additional senior/key persons in an attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Personnel budget fields
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Other Personnel — Number of personnel by project role, Calendar/Academic/Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits ($), and Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide counts and full budget detail for postdoctoral associates, graduate students, undergraduates, clerical staff, training coordinators, and other personnel categories as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment reporting threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment Description — List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify each equipment item over $5,000 with cost and include total equipment requested for the budget period. Smaller equipment belongs in Other Direct Costs / Materials and Supplies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel cost categories
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel — Separate Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide funds requested for each travel category, specify per-trip components (airfare, per diem, visa fees, nights), and justify travel in Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support cost categories
rubrics_metrics.description: E. Participant/Trainee Support Costs — include Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, and Other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report number of participants/trainees and total participant/trainee support costs when the project includes training participants; these are reported separately from personnel salaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs — enumerated items
rubrics_metrics.description: F. Other Direct Costs — example list includes Materials and Supplies; Publication Costs; Consultant Services; ADP/Computer Services; Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; Alterations and Renovations; Training costs; Grants tracking Module; Support for Project Committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize other direct costs by category, provide amounts, and include justification (e.g., materials for training, consultant fees, software development).

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect costs reporting and cognizant agency
rubrics_metrics.description: H. Indirect Costs — Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), Funds Requested ($), Cognizant Federal Agency (Agency Name, POC Name, and POC Phone Number).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the applicable indirect cost rate and base and identify the cognizant federal agency and contact; the example uses the allowed NIH rate of 8% for indirect costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification attachment and content
rubrics_metrics.description: L. Budget Justification* — File Name: Budget_Justification.pdf (Only attach one file.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a single attached budget justification file that explains the rationale for salaries, travel, consultant fees, training costs, equipment, materials, fringe benefits, and other direct costs; include calculation details (e.g., per diem, number of participants, days).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fringe benefits rate reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Fringe benefits for all project personnel are charged at 15%, the approved MakCHS fringe benefit rate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the fringe benefit rate used for budget calculations and what it includes (e.g., statutory national social security fund). Use the institutionally approved fringe rate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consultant services budgeting and justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Consultant services: Funds requested in the amount to cater for consultant fees for trainers; example: 3 trainers (Research Regulatory Specialist, Pre-award Specialist, Post-award Specialist) each budgeted per day for total days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify number and type of consultants, daily rate, number of days, and total cost; justify expertise and necessity in Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project personnel effort reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Report personnel effort as calendar months and/or percent effort (e.g., PD/PI 2.4 calendar months in year 1; 1.2 calendar months in year 2) and indicate percent effort committed to project activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide effort for each senior/key person and other personnel (e.g., training coordinator 50% effort), and budget salary consistent with effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel justification for training and workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget travel for senior administrators to receive hands-on training (specify duration, number of visits, airfare, per-night lodging, meals, incidentals, visa fees) and for attendance at workshops/GMP training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe purpose of travel, number of travelers, per-trip components, and include cost calculations in Budget Justification; align travel with training aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants Tracking Module and IT integration costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants Tracking Module: Development and set up estimated cost and integration onto existing finance management software (e.g., Quickbooks); maintenance costs to be met by institution beyond grant period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide cost estimate and plan for integration and ongoing maintenance; justify as necessary for project objectives (real-time access, secure repository).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-award services (grants administration best-practices)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRE AWARD SERVICES — examples: Developing grants management standard operating procedures, finding funding opportunities, creating and maintaining institutional registrations (SAM.GOV, Grants.gov, eRA Commons), supporting proposal development including budgets and justifications, timely submission of internally approved proposals, conducting pre-award risk assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When describing institutional grants administration capacity or proposing training, enumerate these core pre-award services as expected functions and training topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-award services (grants administration best-practices)
rubrics_metrics.description: POST AWARD SERVICES — examples: Award negotiation and acceptance (reviewing terms and conditions, negotiating awards), award set up and orientation, safe custody of grant documents, project tracking, budget monitoring and compliance to grant regulations, preparing project amendments (budget modifications, carryovers), ensuring timely reporting (financial and programmatic), facilitating audits, successful project close out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this list as the standard scope of post-award administration that the Grants Office should provide; training and systems strengthening should address these functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Vertebrate Animals
rubrics_metrics.description: Vertebrate Animals Section — Are vertebrate animals euthanized? If 'Yes' — Is the method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines? If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer required vertebrate animal questions and provide compliance details; if euthanasia methods deviate from AVMA guidelines, provide justification. Include required documentation where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Program Income Section — Is program income anticipated? If 'Yes', use the format to reflect the amount and source(s) for each Budget Period; if 'No', leave section blank.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declare anticipated program income amounts and sources per budget period when applicable; otherwise leave blank.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Embryonic Stem Cells Section — Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? If 'Yes', list registration number(s) of specific cell line(s) from registry or indicate that a registry line will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide registry numbers (e.g., 0004) or check the box indicating that a registry line will be used; follow NIH stem cell policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Fetal Tissue compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Fetal Tissue Section — Does the project involve human fetal tissue obtained from elective abortions? If 'Yes', provide the HFT Compliance Assurance and sample IRB consent form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply required compliance assurance documents and consent form templates if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents (Renewal applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inventions and Patents Section (Renewal applications) — Does the application involve inventions and patents? If 'Yes', indicate Previously Reported: Yes/No.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For renewals disclose inventions and patent reporting status and provide any required follow-up information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator/Institution reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Change of Investigator/Change of Institution Section — Provide name of former Project Director/Principal Investigator or former grantee institution when applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete change forms and provide required identifying information for prior PD/PI or institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative Budget reporting fields
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - Cumulative Budget — report totals for Sections A–F, Direct Costs (G), Indirect Costs (H), Total Direct and Indirect Costs (I), Fee (J), and Total Costs and Fee (K).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide cumulative totals across budget periods and categories; ensure consistency between period budgets and cumulative summaries.
